newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Q1 industrial output rises 2.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Q1 industrial output rises 2.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Swiss industrial production rose 2.0 pecent in the first quarter of 1996 from the year-earlier period, the Federal Statistics Office said.

The figures, which exclude construction, reflect for the first time a revised system of collecting data that is now based on NOGA international norms, the office said. New indices for production, order inflow, sales and inventory are based on the 1995 average.
